@zxing/library 0.21.3 - TypeScript port of ZXing (1D/2D barcode reader)

Why: iPhone Safari has no BarcodeDetector, so the Daily Success "Find a food"
card (docs/pro/daily-success/js/food-search-ui.js) loads this to read EAN-13 /
EAN-8 / UPC-A barcodes from the camera. Loaded on demand only, when Jo taps
Scan on a browser without BarcodeDetector. Pure JavaScript, no WebAssembly, no
network calls, no eval (checked when vendored).

Source:    https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zxing/library/v/0.21.3
           https://github.com/zxing-js/library
File:      zxing-library-0.21.3.min.js  = umd/index.min.js from the npm tarball,
           byte-identical (no newlines, so line-ending conversion cannot alter it)
sha256:    d7cc8f69dd70bdcf3ac00c9ae572bf2acb9f4132ba379c72df842e4db918652d
Tarball:   sha512-hZHqFe2JyH/ZxviJZosZjV+2s6EDSY0O24R+FQmlWZBZXP9IqMo7S3nb3+2LBWxodJQkSurdQGnqE7KXqrYgow==
           (the npm registry's dist.integrity; the downloaded tarball matched it)
License:   package.json declares MIT; the LICENSE file shipped in the package is
           the Apache License 2.0 text (ZXing's own license). Both permit this
           use. The package's LICENSE is kept next to the file as LICENSE.

To update: npm pack @zxing/library@<version> --ignore-scripts into an empty
directory, check the tarball against the registry's dist.integrity, copy
umd/index.min.js here under the new version name, update the sha256 above, the
path in food-search-ui.js, and tests/tracker-food-search-2026-10-20.test.js.
